tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground under the 40px hairline grid; also the top bar and side nav ground.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: hero, cards, tiles, infobox, table body, modal body.

tokens.name: panel-muted
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: toolbar buttons, kbd caps, chips, table header, filter rail, active nav hover.

tokens.name: panel-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav links and toolbar buttons (panel-muted stepped 5% toward ink).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse slabs: primary button, entity-type stamp, tooltip.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on paper, panel and panel-muted.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper, panel and panel-muted: nav labels, meta, toolbar icons. Measured #6b7280 missed 4.5:1 on panel-muted, so the light value is one step darker.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: English caps captions and dates on paper and panel (the reference draws ink at 70% alpha; this is the flattened solid).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header and footer rules, card edges, table row dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined button and tile edges, kbd caps, dividers that group controls. Decorative only.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of text inputs and the search field, where the boundary is the only cue; 3:1 on paper and panel.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Page hairline grid (1px every grid-cell) and dot-grid dots in the hero.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots inside the archive hero; decorative. Light enough that ink-muted keeps 4.5:1 where text crosses a dot.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: active nav slab, section accent bar, kicker bar, primary accent button, chips, mini bars, brackets, focus glow. A fill, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias of accent for tools that need a primary colour; in this kit, use accent.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed accent, hover on accent fills, the dark edge of rarity-5 and mini-bar peaks.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: active nav wash, highlighted search terms, selected filter wash.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-strong and accent-soft in light; on accent and accent-strong in dark.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and numbers on paper and panel: stat counters, active English caption, links-as-label.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible outline on every control, on paper, panel and panel-muted.

tokens.name: signal-magenta
tokens.usage: Signal strip segment 1 (0-35%) and the modal stripe; decorative.

tokens.name: signal-teal
tokens.usage: Signal strip segment 3 (82-100%), live-sync dot; decorative.

tokens.name: signal-mint
tokens.usage: Modal bottom stripe segment and rarity card strip; decorative.

tokens.name: signal-yellow
tokens.usage: Modal close tile and the modal title accent bar.

tokens.name: on-signal-yellow
tokens.usage: Close glyph on signal-yellow.

tokens.name: modal-head
tokens.usage: Version-notice title bar.

tokens.name: on-modal-head
tokens.usage: Title and icon on modal-head.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Wiki links in body text on paper and panel.

tokens.name: link-missing
tokens.usage: Links to pages that do not exist yet.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Live / urgent status text and its dot, error toasts, on paper, panel and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of live and error chips.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text: synced, created, added bytes; on paper and panel.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and removed bytes; on paper and panel.

tokens.name: bracket
tokens.usage: The [ ] brackets around wiki section titles and hero corner brackets in neutral form.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop at 20% (light) and 55% (dark), through the --scrim-fill custom property.

tokens.name: rarity-1
tokens.usage: Rarity 1 (common): card base strip, star fill and table rarity cell bar. Always beside the star count or the number, never alone.

tokens.name: rarity-2
tokens.usage: Rarity 2 (uncommon): card base strip, star fill and table rarity cell bar. Always beside the star count or the number, never alone.

tokens.name: rarity-3
tokens.usage: Rarity 3 (rare): card base strip, star fill and table rarity cell bar. Always beside the star count or the number, never alone.

tokens.name: rarity-4
tokens.usage: Rarity 4 (epic): card base strip, star fill and table rarity cell bar. Always beside the star count or the number, never alone.

tokens.name: rarity-5
tokens.usage: Rarity 5 (legendary): card base strip, star fill and table rarity cell bar. Always beside the star count or the number, never alone.

tokens.name: rarity-6
tokens.usage: Rarity 6 (mythic): card base strip, star fill and table rarity cell bar. Always beside the star count or the number, never alone.
